organs.mechanism: a generated task is compiled and repaired (up to 5 reflections), judged interesting by an LLM (skipped while the archive is no larger than the seed set), trained on with DreamerV3 warm-started from the most similar archived task's checkpoint, and appended to the archive only if its success detector passes; failures go to append-only reject lists
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: with training or success detection disabled, task_success is set True, so every interesting task enters

organs.mechanism: a chosen task is drawn with probability proportional to a counter that rises by 1 each iteration and is reset to 0 for the tasks used as examples; its nearest archived tasks by cosine distance of code embeddings become the generator's examples, and failed tasks near it are shown as negatives
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the counter array is normalised in place before += 1, so counts are not raw; the chosen task is always its own nearest neighbour

organs.mechanism: the model is shown the new task and its 10 most similar archived tasks and asked whether the new one is novel, surprising, fun to watch, not too easy and useful; the answer is parsed as 'yes' in the first word
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the parse-failure retry calls the method without its robot_desc argument (TypeError)

organs.mechanism: a run is successful if any logged step line reads True; the task succeeds if at least half of the success files do
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: with no success files, 0 >= 0 makes the task count as solved
